properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 20 at 3:12PM EDT until October 21 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Ocean and Eastern Monmouth counties.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction: Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.
